messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The brands of bupropion are FDA-approved for specific conditions.
Wellbutrin SR is used to treat major depressive disorder.
Wellbutrin XL is used to treat MDD and seasonal affective disorder (SAD).
Aplenzin is used to treat MDD and SAD.
Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.
The information on this page is only about bupropion.
It is not about bupropion with dextromethorphan (Auvelity).
It is not about bupropion with naltrexone (Contrave).
Triplet: ["this page", "is about", "bupropion"]

The relation 'is about' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject information page is focused on the entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
B. 'involves': The subject condition or process includes or is characterized by the entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined or described by the specification provided in the object entity.
D. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
E. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
